## Amendments applied at plan time (2 blocking)

1. **BLOCKING** — row flash paints `background-image`, NOT `box-shadow`. `rowStripe`
   already owns `box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0` on `td:first-child` (`src/core/css/table.css:938-940`)
   and keyframes outrank normal author declarations, so the severity bar would
   silently vanish for the full 1.2s of every flash.
2. **BLOCKING** — collection-mode flash DELETED. `_onCollectionReset` → `_buildItems()`
   → `_clearItems()` (`ListView.js:2013`) destroys every item view, so the
   "row element survives a render" premise is false exactly there. Flash is
   models-mode only.
3. `interval` fallback struck — the AC names `every`; the workspec notes say "pick one".
4. TablePage `autoRefreshIndicator` forwarding dropped — the AC says TablePage
   forwarding stays untouched. Real gap, filed separately.
5. Stale-response guard added (`lastFetchTime` snapshot) — `refreshModels` uses the
   view's own AbortController, so `Collection.fetch()` will not cancel it and a
   mid-tick filter change would write old-context values into fresh models.
6. Diff against `m.attributes[k]`, not `m.get(k)` (`Model.get` splits on `.` and `|`);
   sorted-key compare for object-valued fields.
